description: SPEC.md §7: a 16-note English sample corpus authored for this project (not scraped, no licence question) — ~5 notes across each of 3 loosely related topics plus one deliberate singleton outlier. 16 clears every floor (percentile >=5, cluster >=15, outlier >=3), so a visitor with nothing to paste sees the map, the groups, and the outlier flag on first load. Authored fresh for graticule; not derived from any external source.

notes.text: Booked the moving truck for Saturday morning — still need to confirm the exact pickup window.
Need to buy more boxes; the kitchen alone is going to take a dozen at least.
Called the new building's leasing office to ask about reserving the elevator for move-in day.
Forgot to update the mailing address with the bank before the move — have to do that this week.
The moving company wants a deposit before Saturday; need to send that transfer today.
Thinking about braised short rib for the dinner party, but need to check if anyone's vegetarian first.
Picked up fresh rosemary and thyme at the market for the roast chicken recipe.
The sourdough starter needs feeding twice a day now that the kitchen's warmer.
Should double-check the guest list against food allergies before finalizing the menu.
Tried a new pasta dough recipe last night — it needed a lot more resting time than I gave it.
Ran 8km this morning; pace felt slower than usual, might just be the humidity.
Need new running shoes soon — the current pair is well past 500km.
Signed up for the half marathon in October; the training plan starts next Monday.
Left knee felt a little tight after yesterday's hill repeats — icing it tonight.
Switched to a lighter breakfast before morning runs; it seems to help with the side stitch.
Passport renewal appointment is at 9:15am on Thursday — bring the old passport and two photos.
